name: Migration Path Decision Tree
description: Determines the optimal migration approach based on customer situation, risk tolerance, and timeline.

nodes.question: How many months until contract expires?

nodes.recommendation: Start with modules that have highest licensing cost on source platform. Often: Events Management (separate Engage license), CLM (Vault license), or Sample Management (compliance add-on).
Map all source platform modules currently in use. Prioritize modules with highest user count first for maximum consolidation impact.
Target platform strengths: AI/Next Best, agentic workflows, Data Cloud integration, native platform ecosystem. Start with the module where feature gap is most painful.
Prioritize: (1) Consent Management for GDPR/privacy, (2) Sample Management for PDMA/DEA, (3) Events for Sunshine Act. Compliance modules cannot be deferred.

nodes.name: Fast-Track Migration (< 6 months)

phases.activity: Foundation: User, Account, Territory + Data Migration planning
Core modules: parallel configuration + integration testing

risks: High — no rollback once source is decommissioned
Training gaps lead to adoption issues
mitigations: Run parallel systems for 30 days post go-live

nodes.name: Standard Migration (6-12 months)
risks: Medium — extended dual-system period increases cost
mitigations: Clear wave success criteria before proceeding

nodes.name: Phased Migration (> 12 months)

phases.activity: Core module migration (one at a time, validate each)

risks: Low technical risk, high cost risk (dual licensing)
mitigations: Fixed scope per phase with formal sign-off
Monthly cost tracking vs. migration ROI
